name: Number of graphs with n vertices that have no induced regular subgraph of order 4 or greater.
link: Paul W. Dyson and Brendan D. McKay, Ramsey numbers for regular induced subgraphs, arXiv:2604.08215 [math.CO] (2026).
Erdős problems database contributors, Computations of F(n) and t(n) from #82.
S. Fajtlowicz, T. McColgan, T. Reid, and W. Staton, Ramsey numbers for induced regular subgraphs, Ars Combinatoria, 39 (1995) 149-154.
Brendan McKay, Ramsey Graphs. See the "Regular induced subgraphs" subsection.
example: An example on 6 vertices is a triangle with an extra vertex attached to each corner.
